summary: plusMINT PO: after a 30-ECTS orientation phase the specialization follows the PO of the analogous bachelor program (Mechatronik). The app label still says 2019; the applicable texts are the plusMINT FPO of 9 November 2020 (Mitteilungsblatt 5/2021, in force from WS 2021/22) and, for every Schwerpunkt examination rule, the Mechatronik FPO of 5 July 2023 (Mitteilungsblatt 18/2023, PO-2023). PO 2023 section 7: compulsory basic phase and main phase modules, one of the two specializations (Maschinenbau or Elektrotechnik/Informatik) with 22 ECTS of advanced modules (at least 6 ECTS practical competencies) and an approved study plan. Section 8 sets the thesis module at 15 ECTS. Specialization exams require 77 ECTS from the basic phase, including 2 ECTS of freely chosen key qualifications.

categories.name: One specialization of your choice
categories.note: Mechatronik PO 2023 section 7(6): choose one specialization and take 22 ECTS of advanced modules from that specialization alone, including at least 6 ECTS of practical competencies. An approved study plan is required; the 6 ECTS practical share is not checked as its own slot.
